summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Fidelity Enhanced U.S. All-Cap Equity ETF (FEAC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is actively managed, investing in US equity securities across all market capitalizations. The fund aims for capital growth FEAC was launched on Nov 19, 2024 and is issued by Fidelity.

holdings.infoBox: FEAC is an equity ETF with a total of 426 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.71%, Apple at 7.22%, Microsoft at 4.65%, Alphabet at 3.89%, and Broadcom at 2.79%.
